seo.title: SQLite client for {devices}
seo.description: Open SQLite files on your Mac or over SSH, load extensions such as sqlite-vec and SpatiaLite, and change structure through table rebuilds you review first.

header.title: SQLite client
header.lead: Open a SQLite file on your Mac or over SSH, run SQL, and review structure changes before they run.

bands.title: Open a database file
text: Pick a file or drag it onto TablePro, or open .db, .sqlite and .sqlite3 files from Finder; a new path creates a database. Files are identified by their SQLite format 3 header, not their extension, and protected folders such as Messages or Safari history need Full Disk Access.

In the Remote File pane, On the Server queries the live file over SSH and needs python3 there, and As a Read-Only Copy downloads a snapshot over SFTP. Help > Open Sample Database opens Chinook, a small music-store sample that comes with the app.

bands.title: Query and extensions
text: The driver includes SQLite, independent of your macOS version, and draws <explain>EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN</explain> as a diagram. When another program changes the file, the sidebar reloads on its own.

Load extensions such as sqlite-vec or SpatiaLite per connection. Extension lists that arrive by import, sync or a linked folder need your approval before they load, and the load_extension() SQL function is blocked.

bands.title: Structure
text: Renaming a table or a column, adding or dropping a column and, from SQLite 3.53, adding or dropping a CHECK run as ALTER TABLE. Other <structure>Structure tab</structure> changes rebuild the table: TablePro writes the script, copies the rows with their rowids, restores indexes and triggers, and runs it only after you confirm.

A type change re-reads values through the new affinity, so '007' becomes 7 in an INTEGER column, and the review says so first. A virtual table, such as an FTS5 table, cannot be rebuilt. Table maintenance shows VACUUM, ANALYZE, REINDEX and an integrity check before they run, and Backup Dump writes a .sql file with {dumpTool}.

moveData: <importData>Import</importData> {importFormats} files, or open a data file in the <dataFiles>Data Files window</dataFiles> and import it from there. Tables and results export as {exportFormats}, and <copy>Copy To</copy> moves tables and rows to another engine.
iphone: Pick a database file, create a new one or open the Chinook sample, then browse tables as cards, filter them, edit rows that have a primary key and run SQL in the Query tab.

faq.question: Can TablePro open an encrypted SQLite database?
faq.answer: No. SQLCipher and SEE files do not open, because the bundled SQLite takes no key. Decrypt the file with the sqlcipher tool first.

faq.question: Which SQLite version does TablePro use?
faq.answer: SQLite {engineVersion}, built into the driver. It does not depend on the version that comes with macOS.

faq.question: Can I open my app’s development database?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the file where your framework keeps it, such as db/development.sqlite3 in Rails or db.sqlite3 in Django. Files under ~/Library, iOS Simulator containers included, need Full Disk Access.
